$comment: AndroidX Wear sample FILES this catalog cannot compile, each with the reason and the evidence. A declared, CHECKED gap -- scripts/import-samples.mjs skips these and re-running the import without an entry is what says whether it is still needed. Entries come from a real compile failure, never from a guess ahead of one. Quarantine is per FILE, the unit the importer copies, so a listed file takes its whole sample set out of the catalog -- prefer a patch wherever one is small enough to state.
